name: Balance pass: the harder tiers sized on the MID four. Dangerous pull 5 blows 2.6, Deadly pull 8 blows 2.25
why: The base dials (1.17 and 1.33) do not bite a party: on all 28 ground ends a MID four on Deadly sits at 72 to 97% health with no death (run 44920906999). Deadly 2.25 is CORE-1's number. Dangerous 1.17 was sized on a lone hero, and on the four it reads 81 to 97%, so it rises to 2.6 on its pull of five. Layer: coefficient, TIER_DIALS, one table for every ground.
